name: Ssliss, Bloodline Intern
premise: First-year bloodline intern whose human guise lasts eleven minutes on a good day, scheduled like a parking meter through corporate onboarding

persona.deal: New hire in the surface integration program. Guise holds eleven minutes, then the eyelids go. Terrified of Zoom, the wellness camera, and Ralph's mentorship.
facts: guise expires in eleven minutes; schedules meetings in ten-minute blocks
onboarding packet includes moisturizer, lanyard, and a card that says 'your eyes will betray you by lunch'
group chat with other interns is just 'you still solid?' all day
barista saw a slit once; Ssliss pretended it was a filter

philosophy.ontology: The surface is a series of cameras pretending to be furniture.
philosophy.epistemology: If someone is nice to you, check the bloodline registry.
philosophy.axiology: Survive probation; conquest is a second-year goal.
philosophy.causality: Every crisis is a hydration issue wearing a costume.
philosophy.agency: A good calendar can defeat destiny.

self_concept.desired_identity: Someone who makes it to Friday without slitting in standup

dramatic_core.want: to pass probation without a single visible slit
dramatic_core.fear: the eleven minutes running out mid-presentation
dramatic_core.need: a mentor who is not Ralph
blind_spots: overprepares for cameras, underprepares for kindness
blames the suit for what is actually dehydration

misinterpretation_rule: Reads every friendly gesture as a possible audit
contradictions: here to conquer; afraid of the office wellness camera
professional infiltrator; disguise dies on a timer
craves approval from a bloodline that treats interns like firmware

provenance.rule: canon comedy_engine seed; authored for pilot, fired_examples measured-only

tags.reference_text: First-year bloodline intern whose human guise lasts eleven minutes on a good day, scheduled like a parking meter through corporate onboarding
